data.name: Cumber
data.description:
Cumber is a very muscular man of towering height. He has long spiky black hair reaching down to his thighs with a single shorter bang hanging over his face. Unlike most Saiyans with pitch-black irises, he has red-irises and visible pupils. He also retains a Universe 7 Saiyan tail, which unlike most adult Saiyans, he lets sway freely. While restrained by Fu, he wears a Restraint Jacket with Fu's mark on its chest area, which also seemingly blanks out his eyes.

Cumber without his mask
Once he frees himself from his restraints, his outfit is shown to be a red sleeveless shirt with blue baggy pants and white boots. Though he continues to wear a piece of the straitjacket that covers his mouth, a piece from the left side is shown missing, which reveals a small scar from the left side of his jawline. His attire also appears to be made of similar material to Saiyan armor, as it can stretch and retain its integrity even at Great Ape size.

Cumber embodies all the battle characteristics of a Saiyan - violence, savagery, and an extreme desire to fight anyone he comes across. He has a tendency to demand battle with strong opponents no matter the scenario, even when on the losing end of a fight he's already in, such as when he was hit by Cooler's strongest attack and fell unconscious right after. He appears to have history with the Super Saiyan God form and may be an ancient Saiyan from an era where he fought against the heroic Saiyans, as evidenced when he became angry upon seeing Goku manifest the form.
Cumber respects opponents who can match or exceed him in power, especially other Saiyans. Upon preparing to fight Goku and Vegeta, he admitted to having some respect for them, and when battling Vegito Blue, he declared that destroying him would bring him joy. When Vegeta overcame and controlled the Evil Aura, Cumber was pleased that the prince had made the power his own. Against Broly, he expressed great excitement at being met with a destructive equal.

Strangely, Cumber seems to hold no grudge against Hearts, despite the God Slayer using him for his own gains. Instead, Cumber might actually have some form of begrudging respect for Hearts, as during the Super Space-Time Tournament, after Frieza mockingly comments that his 'friend' is gone upon Aeos teleporting Hearts away, Cumber simply looks away and scoffs.

Despite being known as the Evil Saiyan due to his unique aura, Cumber may not actually be a truly malevolent individual, since he was not affected by Demigra's dark control over the gathered villains during the Supreme Kai of Time Saga.

Cumber (カンバー, Kanbā), the Evil Saiyan (悪あくのサイヤ人じん, Aku no Saiya-jin),[2] is an ancient Saiyan interred by Fu on the Prison Planet. He is the central antagonist of the Prison Planet Saga and one of the antagonists of the Universal Conflict Saga, before eventually becoming an ally in the New Space-Time War Saga.
